Excisusin B is implicated in modulating the activity of the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter, indicating a possible regulatory pathway. The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that Morolic Acid may influence the function of the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter via Excisusin B.
